test_title: PYST 63: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held  On 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been divided into four segments. Identify the segment that contains an adverbial usage error.

Mr. Sukesh and / his family / ate the / food greedy.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect use of the word "**greedy**" as an adverb.
 
• The correct adverbial form should be "**greedily**."
 
• Adverbs typically modify verbs and often end in "**-ly**."
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 4** of the sentence.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **4**.

**Correct Sentence:** *"Mr. Sukesh and his family ate the food **greedily**."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1: "ate the"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **2: "Mr. Sukesh and"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **3: "his family"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **4: "food greedy."** – This part of the sentence contains the error, as explained above.
